metadata.title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) — 300 Original Practice Questions (2026)
metadata.examGuideBasis: AWS Certified AI Practitioner AIF-C01 exam guide, version 1.1 (published April 30, 2026)

design.style: Original scenario-based AWS certification practice style inspired by the structure of professional exam-prep questions; no copied or leaked exam questions.
design.highConfidenceTarget: Approximately 80% of the bank is intentionally concentrated on recurring/core objectives and high-probability concepts; the rest broadens coverage across the current blueprint.
design.feedback: Every question includes the correct answer(s), a main explanation, per-option explanations, and an exam tip.

metadata.importantNote: These are original practice questions. No one can guarantee that any practice question will appear on the live AWS exam.
